implementation_boundary.rule: Endpoint names and payloads are a contract for later tasks, not routes implemented by this task.

independent_readiness.core_bpm_health: Existing /health/ready reports only core BPM readiness and must remain true when the local assistant is disabled, absent, incompatible, busy, cancelled, degraded, crashed, or web-offline.
independent_readiness.assistant_ready: True only when a verified compatible local assistant can accept an immediate generation request. It is false for disabled, not-installed, downloading, indexing without an active generation, loading, cancelled, degraded, incompatible, and crashed.
independent_readiness.lexical_search_ready: Always true for a valid documentation installation; it is never conditional on assistant state, model state, web state, or conversation state.
independent_readiness.partial_artifact_rule: A partial, stale, unverified, mixed-generation, or incompatible artifact set never makes assistant_ready true.

rules: The endpoint returns stable state/reason/action keys and locale, not filesystem paths, prompt text, model output, raw exception text, secrets, private URLs, artifact hashes, or provider bodies.
A status response is localized by locale-owned title/detail/action keys. API consumers may use the stable keys; visible prose may not fall back to English in a non-English locale.
state_epoch changes after every completed transition so clients ignore stale streaming, progress, cancellation, and retry events.
A non-ready state never claims an accepted chat request, a citation, a model load, a download, an index build, or web availability that has not actually completed.

localization.fallback_policy: fail closed for visible assistant text; English fallback is forbidden in ru, de, zh-CN, fr, and es-ES except allowlisted identifiers, product names, commands, paths, and API abbreviations
localization.missing_key_behavior: Do not render an English or generic assistant state. Keep localized lexical search available and report the assistant as unavailable through the safe existing localized recovery surface.
localization.review_required_before_release: Human reviewers accept state meaning, action safety, error/recovery clarity, and accessibility wording in each locale.

states.ui_behavior: Assistant entry states that it is off and offers no implicit installation, network, or background start. Lexical search remains the primary available action.
states.api_behavior: Reject chat before scope, retrieval, inference, web, or worker allocation.
states.fallback: Use lexical search and normal /help/ navigation.

states.ui_behavior: Show installation prerequisites, artifact size/license/provenance disclosure, and one explicit install action; do not auto-download on page load, search, or chat attempt.
states.api_behavior: Reject chat without starting a download or worker.
states.fallback: Use lexical search and normal /help/ navigation.

states.ui_behavior: Show only verified bounded progress and a cancel action after explicit installation consent. Do not claim usable artifacts before hash/license/provenance verification and atomic promotion.
states.api_behavior: Reject chat; status may report a bounded progress phase but no local model or index readiness.
states.fallback: Use lexical search while installation continues or is cancelled.

states.ui_behavior: Show that local knowledge is being prepared and never present partial artifacts (chunks/vectors/indexes) as answerable. If an older verified generation exists, remain in ready with background_operation=indexing instead.
states.api_behavior: Reject chat when no active verified generation exists; report only local build progress without source text or paths.
states.fallback: Use lexical search; retain any last known-good assistant generation only through ready/background_operation.

states.ui_behavior: Show that a verified compatible worker is loading; do not show a ready composer, token stream, or web control.
states.api_behavior: Reject chat until worker health, isolation, resource, and artifact checks pass.
states.fallback: Use lexical search and do not wait-block /help/.

states.ui_behavior: Expose a localized accessible composer, stop/clear controls when applicable, local-source citation expectation, and optional-web disclosure. A background update may be shown as background_operation without withdrawing a verified active generation.
states.api_behavior: Accept one immediate generation only when all request, scope, artifact, worker, and resource guards pass; stream only schema-valid answer events.
states.fallback: On any downstream failure transition to the exact safe state and retain lexical search.

states.ui_behavior: Show a localized busy/queued state, stop control for the request owner, and queue position only when safe. Do not accept unbounded retries or conceal that a request is queued.
states.api_behavior: Accept at most the configured single queued request with 202 and an opaque request ID; return 429 when the queue is full. No additional model worker is started.
states.fallback: Use lexical search immediately; cancellation returns a distinct cancelled outcome.

states.ui_behavior: Announce that the requested operation stopped without presenting partial text as complete; preserve the user's editable prompt only in the current memory-only session.
states.api_behavior: Emit one terminal cancellation event, stop stream delivery, and reject a new chat until cleanup transitions to ready, degraded, or crashed.
states.fallback: Use lexical search while cleanup completes.

states.ui_behavior: Explain a bounded safe capability loss without paths, prompts, secrets, stack traces, or false readiness. Do not offer a response whose grounding, security, privacy, or resource guard is degraded.
states.api_behavior: Reject chat and include only stable reason/action keys. A web-only loss uses web-offline instead of degraded when local answering remains safe.
states.fallback: Use lexical search and normal /help/ navigation.

states.ui_behavior: State that the selected artifact set cannot be used together; never silently select a different model/index, downgrade checks, or combine generations.
states.api_behavior: Reject chat before worker start and expose a stable compatibility reason, not raw hashes or filesystem details.
states.fallback: Quarantine the candidate and use lexical search; last known-good generation may be restored only after full verification.

states.ui_behavior: State that the assistant stopped unexpectedly, provide a safe retry/restart path, and never imply that a worker or answer stream remains active.
states.api_behavior: Reject chat, terminate any worker process tree, clear temporary state, and require explicit verified restart; no restart loop.
states.fallback: Use lexical search and keep core BPM and /help/ routes available.

states.ui_behavior: State that external evidence is unavailable and that the assistant remains local-only; do not present stale web results or retry silently.
states.api_behavior: A local-only chat may proceed with 200. A web-requested chat returns a local-only result or explicit web-unavailable disposition and makes no further provider call until a new consented attempt.
states.fallback: Use local citations or abstain; lexical search remains available.

background_operations.rule: Background work is visible but does not change assistant_ready while an active verified generation and healthy worker remain available. Candidate artifacts never serve requests until complete validation and atomic promotion.

transition_guards: Only explicit user consent starts a download or web attempt; page load, lexical search, status polling, and a rejected chat never start network work.
downloading to indexing requires complete artifact verification and atomic promotion into private local storage; verification failure transitions to incompatible or not-installed, never ready.
indexing to loading requires one complete compatible chunk/vector/index/integrity generation; partial artifacts are quarantined.
loading to ready requires worker isolation, no-listener, health, resource, locale, artifact, and security checks to pass.
busy to ready occurs only after a terminal validated answer or full cleanup; cancelled is emitted before ready when the user stops work.
web-offline may not be used to conceal a core local artifact, scope, privacy, resource, or worker failure; such failure transitions to degraded, incompatible, or crashed.
non_goals: This task does not implement the status/chat routes, model lifecycle, artifact download, indexing, worker, UI, locale catalogs, or web provider.
This task does not alter existing deterministic search, search URL/history/filter state, /help/ serving, core BPM health, or current product API readiness.
This task does not permit background installation, silent network access, English visible fallback, partial-artifact serving, hidden model restart, or lexical-search dependency on AI.
